title: End-to-End Verifiable and Robust Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.15521v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning enables multiple parties to train a shared model without centralizing raw data with the help of an aggregator, but introduces integrity risks once participants or infrastructure are not fully trustworthy. Two requirements are particularly important: robustness to poisoned or Byzantine client updates, and verifiability of the aggregator so that clients or third parties can audit the reported aggregation without learning individual updates. Existing work has largely treated these goals separately, and efficient public verifiability for robust, outlier-excluding aggregation remains limited. We present a verifiable federated learning protocol that makes a robust aggregation pipeline publicly auditable. Our design combines cryptographic commitments with non-interactive zero-knowledge proofs to certify both (i) cosine-similarity-based outlier exclusion and (ii) aggregation over the selected set, without revealing individual

translated_title: 端到端可验证且鲁棒的联邦学习
translated_abstract: 联邦学习使多个参与方能够在聚合器的协助下训练共享模型，而无需集中原始数据，但一旦参与者或基础设施并非完全可信，就会引入完整性风险。其中有两个要求尤为重要：一是对被投毒或拜占庭客户端更新的鲁棒性，二是聚合器的可验证性，使客户端或第三方能够在不获知个体更新的情况下审计所报告的聚合结果。现有工作大多将这两个目标分开处理，而对鲁棒的、排除离群值的聚合实现高效的公开可验证性仍然有限。我们提出了一种可验证的联邦学习协议，使鲁棒的聚合流水线可以被公开审计。我们的设计将密码学承诺与非交互式零知识证明相结合，以同时证明：(i) 基于余弦相似度的离群值排除过程，以及 (ii) 对所选定集合的聚合，且不泄露个体更新。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可验证的联邦学习协议，通过结合密码学承诺与非交互式零知识证明，使鲁棒聚合流程（包括基于余弦相似度的离群值排除及聚合）可被公开审计，同时不泄露任何个体客户端更新。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a verifiable federated learning protocol that combines cryptographic commitments with non-interactive zero-knowledge proofs to make the robust aggregation pipeline (including cosine-similarity-based outlier exclusion and aggregation) publicly auditable without revealing individual client updates.
